title: Published Spotlight pages show the member's bio and every block they authored, not just Links and Top Friends

source.ref: Spotlight audit 2026-10-07 (owner ask: 'Do a little audit of the Spotlight system. Is that all up and running?').

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-07. THE CONSEQUENCE: the public /spotlight/<handle> body renders through the member block grid, and with no saved grid (true for all 4 members with a Spotlight in production) resolveRows fell back to the IN-APP starter, links then topfriends. That starter leaves out About because the in-app chrome shows the bio, but the public page passes showBio={false} because About is meant to own it, so no public Spotlight showed a bio. Every block members authored in meta.spotlight.layout (headings, galleries, images, quotes, embeds) was kept but never placed: danieltyack showed only a header and the join card. THE FIX: lib/spotlight/public-grid.ts publicSpotlightGrid builds the public default from what the member wrote (About, each authored block type in first-seen order, then Links and Top Friends) and the page passes it as the grid; a saved grid still wins. LEFT: the Guestbook block is still not placed on the public page, because it reads the session and the page is ISR with no cookies(); placing it is its own decision.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const miss=[];if(!/grid=\{publicSpotlightGrid\(data\.grid, data\.layout\.blocks\)\}/.test(r('app/spotlight/[handle]/page.tsx')))miss.push('the public Spotlight renders the in-app starter, so it has no bio and drops authored blocks');const g=r('lib/spotlight/public-grid.ts');if(!/const ids: string\[\] = \['about'\]/.test(g)||!/for \(const block of authored\)/.test(g))miss.push('the public starter does not lead with About and place authored blocks');if(miss.length){console.error('SCAN-815: '+miss.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
